arcade_baker.text: Warm Welsh cakes, straight from the bakestone. Do not blow on them. Just burn your tongue like everyone else.
In Welsh they are picau ar y maen, cakes on the stone. Maen is stone, so the old way was a flat griddle stone over a fire.
Cardiff is famous for its Victorian and Edwardian arcades. They kept shoppers dry long before umbrellas were any good, and still do.

arcade_shopper.text: I came in for one thing and left with a hat, a record and a bag of sweets. The arcade does that.
